title: EventStreamEvent
description: A single event in the per-subject timeline event stream (PR27F).

subject_id.description: Subject this event belongs to. Required; cross-subject access blocked.

gumi_instance_id.description: Gumi instance that generated or received this event.

hermes_profile_id.description: Delivery profile used for this event.

event_class.description: Functional class of the event (e.g., checkin, proactive_support).

delivered.description: Whether the event was delivered to the subject.

policy_snapshot.description: Policy state at time of event.

content_preview.description: Short redacted preview of event content (max 80 chars).

raw_content_availability.description: Availability level for raw event content.

eligible_for_user_model.description: Whether this event is eligible as user-model evidence.

eligible_for_experience_analysis.description: Whether this event is eligible for experience analysis.

related_inference_ids.description: List of inference IDs related to this event.

related_correction_ids.description: List of correction IDs related to this event.

initiator.description: Who or what initiated the event.

risk_level.description: Boundary risk level associated with this event.

has_user_response.description: Whether a user response exists for this event.

has_correction.description: Whether a correction is associated with this event.

has_boundary_risk.description: Whether a boundary risk flag exists for this event.

has_media.description: Whether media (image/audio/music) is attached to this event.
